description: Plans a trip by public transport of the TTC in Tbilisi between two points, given as coordinates. Returns up to 3 itineraries with each leg: walk or ride, route, stops, instants, distance in metres. Use transit_search_places to get coordinates.

date.description: The date of depart_at or arrive_by, YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today in Tbilisi.

kinds.description: The kinds to ride: bus, minibus, metro, cable_car. bus and minibus go together. Empty gives every kind. A walk is always allowed.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

preference.description: fastest, less_walking, or fewer_transfers. The default is fastest.

time.description: The time of depart_at or arrive_by, HH:MM in Tbilisi. Required with them.

timing.description: leave_now, depart_at, or arrive_by. The default is leave_now.

name: transit_plan_trip

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the plan, RFC 3339.

itineraries.description: Up to 3 ways to travel, in the order of the TTC.

duration_minutes.description: The duration in minutes, rounded up.

legs.description: The parts of the trip, in order.

distance_m.description: The distance of the leg in metres, rounded.

end.description: The instant at which the leg ends, RFC 3339.

name.description: The name of the stop or the point.

stop_id.description: The stop id. Absent when the point is not a stop.

kind.description: walk, bus, minibus, metro, or cable_car.

route_name.description: The route name of a ride.

route_number.description: The route number of a ride.

start.description: The instant at which the leg starts, RFC 3339.

stops.description: The count of stops of a ride after the boarding stop.

name.description: The name of the stop or the point.

stop_id.description: The stop id. Absent when the point is not a stop.

transfers.description: The count of changes from one vehicle to another.

walk_m.description: The total distance of walk in metres, rounded.

source.description: The source of the data: TTC.

title: Plan a trip by public transport in Tbilisi
